newsitem.title: ITALY: Policeman suspected in family slayings in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Policeman suspected in family slayings in Italy.

text.p: Six people from the same family, including an 11-year-old girl, were found shot dead early on Wednesday at a house in southern Italy and police said an officer suspected in the slayings had given himself up.
The killings occurred late on Tuesday at the home of an elderly couple in the town of Diamante on the toe of Italy.
One victim was the estranged wife of a Carabinieri paramilitary police officer, Alfredo Valente, and the other five his in-laws including the woman's parents, aged 82 and 75.
A Carabinieri spokesman said Valente had turned himself in at a police station in Brescia, northern Italy, after apparently driving there through the night.
Two children Valente had taken with him from Diamante, his four-year-old daughter and a three-year-old niece, were found safe at the home of a relative in Brescia.
